meta.title: Sleep guard
meta.description: Refuses shell commands that would block the whole turn — foreground sleeps of 20 seconds or more, follow-mode log readers, and dev servers — and names run_in_background with job_output as the alternative. Covers bash, pwsh, pwsh_persistent and shell, plus ops_bash when the dsh-ops package is installed; quoted text and run_in_background calls pass through. Detection is pattern-based, so nested forms such as bash -c or command substitution are not caught.
